description: The science and practice of diagnosing, treating, and preventing disease, and maintaining human health.

subdomains.name: General Medicine
subdomains.description: Diagnosis and non-surgical treatment of a broad range of adult illnesses.

subdomains.name: Surgery
subdomains.description: Operative procedures to treat injuries, diseases, and deformities of the body.

subdomains.name: Cardiology
subdomains.description: Specializes in diagnosis and treatment of diseases of the heart and blood vessels.

subdomains.name: Neurology
subdomains.description: Focuses on disorders of the brain, spinal cord, and nervous system.

subdomains.name: Pediatrics
subdomains.description: Medical care for infants, children, and adolescents.

subdomains.name: Oncology
subdomains.description: Diagnosis and treatment of cancer, including chemotherapy, radiation, and surgery.

subdomains.name: Dentistry
subdomains.description: Diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of diseases and conditions of the oral cavity.

subdomains.name: Nursing
subdomains.description: Patient care, health promotion, and support across clinical settings.

subdomains.name: Pharmacy
subdomains.description: The science of preparing, dispensing, and understanding the effects of medications.

subdomains.name: Mental Health
subdomains.description: Diagnosis and treatment of psychological and psychiatric conditions.

subdomains.name: Nutrition
subdomains.description: The study of how food and diet affect health and bodily function.

subdomains.name: Public Health
subdomains.description: Protects and improves health at the population level through policy and prevention.
